title: Open modular functors from non-finite tensor categories
summary: We show that a compact rigid balanced braided monoidal category with enough compact projective objects gives rise to a system of mapping class group representations compatible with the gluing along marked intervals. A motivation to consider non-finite tensor categories is the theory of vertex operator algebras where such categories arise as categories of modules. The mapping class group representations presented in this article admit a factorization homology description.
